hypothesis.statement: A curve stored in the native AnimInstance is only staged input and does not prove the MetaHuman Control Rig graph evaluated or consumed it.
hypothesis.action: Issue a monotonic token and deterministic digest per facial batch, hide staged curves from QA readback, and require the Anim Blueprint to acknowledge the exact current token after its Control Rig node consumes the map.
hypothesis.expectedResult: P36 capture and runtime viseme confirmation can distinguish staged transport from graph-consumed facial control values.

implementation.digest: MD5 over lexically sorted curve names and six-decimal weights

scopeBoundary: acknowledgement proves graph consumption, not correct visual deformation
the UE 5.6 face Anim Blueprint still must call acknowledgement after Control Rig evaluation
P12 geometry diagnostics and human review remain required
failureHandling: reject zero, stale or future acknowledgement tokens
do not expose staged Control Rig values as observed evidence
time out a P36 sample if the graph does not acknowledge within ten seconds
reject missing or malformed per-sample token/digest evidence
reject fabricated Control Rig evidence on morph-only mappings
decision: Accept Control Rig evidence only after exact-token graph acknowledgement and subsequent consumed-snapshot readback.
